title: Barnaby and the Crimson Kick
idea: In a bustling Japanese port town, Barnaby, an energetic sea otter, dreams of leading the beloved crimson-and-white soccer squad to glory. When the club qualifies for a crucial championship showdown on October twenty-seventh, the stakes skyrocket: a snooty developer threatens to pave over their historic seaside pitch unless they win. Disaster strikes when the star striker catches a cold, forcing timid Barnaby onto the field. But just as kickoff starts, Barnaby discovers the rival captain is actually an ultra-advanced soccer robot studying their every move.
visual: A sunlit coastal stadium overlooking a sparkling blue bay, where an expressive sea otter in a crimson-and-white sports kit bounds across the emerald grass alongside colorful animal teammates. The atmosphere is vibrant, warm, and brimming with comedic underdog energy.
